question: Which of the following elements is a metalloid?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Silicon**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Silicon is the metalloid** among the given elements: 
 
• Silicon:
 
 
• **A metalloid is an element that has properties of both metals and nonmetals**.
 
 
 
• Silicon** has a metallic luster but is not a good conductor of electricity.**
 
• **Silicon is used to make alloys with iron and aluminum in the steel and automotive industries. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Iron:**

 
 
• It is a metal
 
• Symbol: Fe; Atomic number: 26.
 
• It is a strong, malleable, and ductile metal widely used in construction and manufacturing.
 
• It is essential for human health; a key component of haemoglobin in red blood cells.
 
 
 
• **Oxygen (O**)
 
 
• Symbol: O; Atomic number: 8.
 
• It is a colourless, odourless gas making up 21% of Earth's atmosphere.
 
• It is Vital for respiration in living organisms; and supports combustion.
 
 
 
• **Sodium (Na)**
 
 
• Symbol: Na; Atomic number: 11.
 
• A soft, silvery metal that reacts vigorously with water.
 
• It is essential for nerve function and maintaining fluid balance
